info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Mortgage Loans Preapprovals-v1-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loans Preapproval List API enables users to retrieve a comprehensive list of mortgage loan preapprovals. This endpoint is primarily designed for lenders and financial institutions seeking to access and present preapproved loans to potential homebuyers. By leveraging this API, developers can seamlessly integrate preapproval data into their applications, enhancing the user experience and streamlining the loan application process. Typical use cases include displaying available preapproval options in mortgage calculators or personalized dashboards for clients.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to check the pre-approval status for loans based on the provided criteria. It returns information on whether a loan is pre-approved or not, facilitating quicker access to loan options for potential borrowers.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a preapproval process for a loan. The client needs to provide necessary information in JSON format to determine eligibility and conditions for preapproval.

ListMortgageLoansPreapprovalsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to loan preapproval.

status.description: Indicates whether the preapproval request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the preapproval request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the preapproval operation.

state.description: Current state of the preapproval request.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the preapproval request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the preapproval result.

audit.description: Audit information about the preapproval request.

ListMortgageLoansPreapprovalsResponse_20.description: Response schema for the preapproval operation.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the preapproval request.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the preapproval request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the preapproval request was created automatically.

Audit.description: Contains information about the audit trail of the preapproval request.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
